code_standard: MCA GB/T 2260 (6-digit province/prefecture/county) + 12-digit verifiable township/street layer
normalization_rules: Skip 4 synthetic province-direct county group placeholders (419000, 429000, 469000, 659000); parent their county rows directly to their province node.
Municipalities (110000 Beijing, 120000 Tianjin, 310000 Shanghai, 500000 Chongqing) carry no synthetic prefecture tier; their districts parent directly to the municipality node.
Mark direct-administered prefecture cities without county subdivisions (441900 Dongguan, 442000 Zhongshan, 460400 Danzhou, 620200 Jiayuguan) as is_terminal_official = true.
Tag Taiwan (71*), Hong Kong (81*), and Macau (82*) nodes with market_scope = hk_mo_tw so mainland freight auto-quotes never silently apply.
Deduplicate the 3 repeated records sharing township code 659001100000 and retain alternate spellings (石北泉镇, 石总场北泉镇) as region_aliases.
